description_en: Queries the Wuying Workstation workload templates available for a specified virtual node pool
description_zh: 查询指定虚拟节点池可用的无影工作站工作负载模板
name: ListWuyingServerWorkloadTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual node pool. This parameter is required. The node pool must belong to the current account. You can call [ListWuyingServer](~~ListWuyingServer~~) to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点池 ID，必填。节点池必须属于当前账号；可调用 [ListWuyingServer](~~ListWuyingServer~~) 获取
parameters.name: virtual_node_pool_id

parameters.help_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not read this parameter. The operation returns a fixed maximum of the first 100 templates
parameters.help_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不读取该参数；接口固定最多返回前 100 条模板
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not read this parameter and does not support token-based pagination
parameters.help_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不读取该参数，不支持使用令牌翻页
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not use this field to indicate the number of returned entries
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不使用该字段表达返回条数

NextToken.description_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not generate a next page token
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不生成下一页标记

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题

WorkloadTemplates.description_en: The list of workload templates. Up to 100 templates are returned, sorted by template configuration order
WorkloadTemplates.description_zh: 工作负载模板列表，按模板配置顺序返回，最多 100 条

items.description_zh: 工作负载模板列表对象

Content.description_en: The rendered template content. The original text is Base64-encoded after being encoded in UTF-8. You must decode the Base64 string before use
Content.description_zh: 渲染后的模板正文。原文按 UTF-8 编码后进行 Base64 编码；使用时先执行 Base64 解码

Description.description_en: The description of the workload template
Description.description_zh: 工作负载模板的用途说明
Description.example: 用于提交通用计算工作负载。

Name.description_en: The name of the workload template
